zh: 合法子串只能由两段相邻的不同字符组成，所以它一定横跨某一对相邻游程（极长连续相同字符段）的分界线。
把字符串压缩成游程长度序列。对于长度为 p、q 的一对相邻游程，以分界线为中心向两边各取 t 个字符（t=1..min(p,q)），恰好得到 min(p,q) 个合法子串。
一次扫描即可：维护上一段长度 previous 和当前段长度 current；字符变化时把 min(previous,current) 加进答案，并令 previous=current、current=1；扫描结束后再加一次 min(previous,current)。答案可达约 10^10，用 64 位整数。时间 O(n)，空间 O(1)。
en: A valid substring consists of exactly two adjacent blocks of different characters, so it always straddles the boundary between some pair of adjacent runs (maximal blocks of equal characters).
Compress the string into run lengths. For adjacent runs of lengths p and q, taking t characters on each side of the boundary (t = 1..min(p, q)) gives exactly min(p, q) valid substrings.

One pass is enough: keep the previous run length previous and the current run length current; when the character changes, add min(previous, current) to the answer and set previous = current, current = 1; after the scan, add min(previous, current) once more. The answer can reach about 10^10, so use 64-bit integers. Time O(n), space O(1).

explanationEn:
## Approach

Compress the string into the lengths of runs of equal adjacent characters. Each pair of adjacent runs with lengths p and q forms min(p,q) qualifying substrings.

## Correctness

A valid substring must consist of only two adjacent blocks of different characters, so it corresponds uniquely to one pair of adjacent runs. For two runs of lengths p and q, taking t characters from each run at their boundary gives the valid substrings for t=1..min(p,q), and there are no other valid substrings. Each substring belongs to exactly one run pair without overlap, so the sum is exactly the total.

## Complexity

Let n be the string length. Time O(n), space O(1).
